id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the graph.

cacheKey.description: The cache key of the whole in-memory graph.

clearGraphWarningModalComponentId.description: The modal to display warning on clear graph click.

clusterConfig.description:
The configuration for clustering nodes within a certain pixel radius when
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualization#showMap} is true.

clusterNodeFillColor.description: The fill color of a cluster node in map mode.

clusterNodeOutlineColor.description: The outline color of a cluster node in map mode.

collapseCombinedNodesOnLoad.description: Whether or not to initial render the graph in a combined / grouped state.

geoJsonData.description: The data passed to Leaflet to display on the tile layer on the map.

graphView.description: The configuration for the graph view.

mapboxUrl.description: The Mapbox URL loaded with the API token required for rendering Mapbox tiles.

mergedEdgesMapping.description: The dictionary to store the mapping from an original edge id to its merged edge id.

nodeColorGroupings.description:
The color grouping for the nodes based on category if
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeStyleConfig#fillColorByProperty} is set to
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyCategorical} type.

nodeCombineColorGroupings.description: The color grouping for the combined nodes.

nodeInfoGlyph.description: The loaded glyph to display the number of nodes in a closed combo node.

pingConfig.description: The configuration for a temporarily animated halo effect to a node or a link, also known as a ping effect.

regionHoverStyle.description: The style to apply to GeoJson region on hover.

regionSelectStyle.description: The style to apply to GeoJson region on select.

resetGraphWarningModalComponentId.description: The modal to display warning on reset graph button click.

reversedCombineProperties.description:
The list of properties associated with the combined nodes listed in the reverse order
(from the lowest to highest granularity).

selectionConfig.description: The configuration to control the appearance of selected items.

timeBarBackgroundColor.description: The background color for the time bar.

timeBarColor.description: The color used for the bars of the time bar.

timeBarHoverColor.description: The color when a bar in the time bar is hovered on by the user.

timeBarIsDimmingMode.description: Whether the time bar is in dimming mode or filtering mode.

timeBarIsHistogram.description: Whether the time bar should display a histogram.

timeBarScaleHoverColor.description: The color of the time bar scale section that is hovered over.

useSummaryLinks.description: Whether multiple links between 2 groups should be displayed as a single link.

title: The presentational component for a {@link UiSdlGraphVisualization} instance.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationPresentationalComponent
